title: An idea becomes a connected system — collision instrument with band-owned sculpture

scenes.title: Collision instrument drives the system
scenes.purpose: Show the full chain from contact to response, driven by one shared demo cue table. Each struck bar plays a note, and band-mapped sculpture parts plus the network grow the idea into a connected system.
visuals: Cool drafting-sheet ground #DFE6E8 with a stationary grid
Three tuned bars on posts: C3 bass (#628C98), G3 mid (#BA7B61), E4 treble (#628C98)
Ink #293B44 ball dropping and rebounding between the bars
Dark #293B44 SYSTEM panel holding the sculpture: IDEA core, six aperture blades, a bass piston and a treble halo
Network nodes and pale edges growing from the IDEA hub
Cue strip with a tick at each contact time

beats.development: The SYSTEM panel unfolds; after it completes, its labels and the closed sculpture appear. The ball falls toward the bass bar.
Cue c1 (C3 bass, 0.50 s): the bar compresses, a ring ripples out and the bar brightens for 0.40 s. The piston extends (bass owner), the aperture opens (transient owner) and the IDEA core grows.
Dense run: c2 G3 at 1.00 s, c3 E4 at 1.25 s (the halo brightens, treble owner) and c4 G3 at 1.45 s. Each hit opens the aperture, draws an edge and adds a node.
Rest: the ball hangs in a high arc. Bars, piston, aperture and halo all return to rest.

Final c5 C3 bass hit at 2.20 s: deepest compression, the widest ring, full piston extension and the widest aperture opening. Three edges close loops and the last node lands. Everything is still by 2.7 s.

findings: Contacts are unevenly spaced (0.50, 1.00, 1.25, 1.45, 2.20 s), so density varies across the clip.
Each response starts on its contact frame, and the 70 ms dwell lets the impact read before the rebound.
The bass, transient and treble properties each have a single owner, so pulses never conflict.
justifiedHolds: 1.52–2.20 s: a rest before the final hit, with every part back at rest.
2.70–3.00 s: a settled hold so the finished system can be read.

notes: Covers both recipes: collision_instrument (contact → compression → ring → brightening) and audio_reactive_sculpture (bass → piston, transient → aperture, treble → halo, all bounded).
The cue table is authored for demonstration, not analyzed. GSAP labels c1–c5 come from it. audioPlaceAt = contact − 0.012 s sample attack, reserved for a full video.
